text: Julia and Damian got engaged on Saturday night, he proposed on the beach in Tenby. Wedding probably summer 2027.
Camila's due 14 March 2027!! She's had awful morning sickness so go gently.
omar bday fri 7 nov. into vinyl atm, mentioned wanting a proper record cleaning kit
Need to send Chen and Vikram an anniversary card, theirs is the 22nd. Ten years apparently.
Christening for baby Rosa is Sunday 9 November 2026 at 11am, St Mary's. Adriana asked if I'd be godmother, I said yes obviously.
Jamal's wedding's off. He and Kerry split up last month, he's not really talking about it. Should check in on him next week.
Karan mentioned Shreya's 40th is coming up on 3 December, she's been hinting heavily about a pasta machine.
Tanvi had the baby! Little boy, born Tuesday at 4am, 7lb 2. Send congrats and maybe drop round a lasagne at the weekend.

so I was chatting to Nikolai, uh, at the school gate this morning and he said his wife is expecting again, due around April 2027, and they haven't decided whether to find out the gender, he seemed pretty chuffed, and their older one Mia is starting reception next September so it's going to be a busy year for them, he also said his boss has been weird about paternity leave
Reggie's dog Biscuit turns one on Thursday lol. He's doing a cake.
Pieter - anniversary dinner Sat 6pm w/ his wife, booked the Italian place. he asked me to cover his shift.
Remind me to ask Rhys how the proposal went. He was planning it for last night at the top of Pen y Fan.
Eli loves bouldering, climbs three times a week. Also collects old Polaroid cameras. Good for xmas list.
Pick up the cake for my own birthday drinks, Friday 6:30pm. Collect from Gail's on the way.
Duc and his partner are renewing their vows in Hanoi in May 2027, the whole family's flying out. His mum is apparently thrilled.
Milan nervous about his best man speech, wedding is the 15th. Said he's rewritten it four times. Text him good luck that morning.
Ravi's sister Mia is getting married on 18 April 2027 in Lisbon. He's hoping to do a bit of a road trip around it.
Marta turned 30 yesterday, I completely forgot. Must get her something this week, she's into ceramics, maybe a class voucher.
moira's grandson christened sun. she sent pics, he screamed the whole way through apparently

Call with Kenji. His wife Lila had a scan Friday at 10 and everything looks fine, twins!! Due 2 February 2027. He sounded overwhelmed but in a good way. They're going to need a bigger car, he says, and her parents are moving closer to help. Ask him next month how Lila's feeling.
Michael's anniversary is the 30th. Twenty five years with Patrick. Don't forget to chip in for the gift, Khadija's organising.
Alice is struggling a bit, IVF round didn't work. Don't mention babies. Maybe take her for coffee next week.
Siddharth - into F1 and craft gin. Birthday 19 Jan.
Julia's mum's 70th is on Saturday 1 November 2026 at 7pm, surprise party at the golf club. Julia's doing the slideshow and asked for old photos.
engagement drinks for Camila and Omar thurs 8pm at the Crown. take card
Damian said the baby's not sleeping at all, they're both exhausted. He's back at work Monday. I should drop off some food tomorrow morning.
Chen Zhou, aka CZ from five a side, just told me he's proposing at Christmas. Ring's already bought. Total secret.

Vikram's wedding is Sat 12 June 2027, at 2pm, in Jaipur. Save the date arrived today. Need to sort flights by January. It's a three day thing, mehndi on the Thursday evening, then the ceremony, then a reception on the Sunday at noon. His fiancee Khadija says dress code is bright colours, no black or white. Vikram also asked if I'd do a reading.
Gift idea for Adriana: she keeps talking about that Le Creuset casserole dish in the sage green.
Jamal's brother Sam is getting married next spring, Jamal is best man and freaking out about the stag.
note to self: book the venue tasting for 4 Dec 2026 at 2pm, and pay the florist deposit before Friday
Kerry's daughter has her first birthday party on the 25th at 3pm. Theme is Bluey apparently. She'd love anything Bluey.
Karan and Tanvi celebrating their first anniversary in Paris next weekend. He wanted restaurant recs, send him that list.
Shreya's pregnant! Only 10 weeks so not telling people yet. Due date roughly mid May 2027. She's been feeling really rough, mostly in the evenings.

Nikolai's mum died in August, he mentioned the anniversary of her death is hard because it falls on his wedding anniversary. Be kind around 14 Nov. His wife Alice usually takes him away somewhere quiet that weekend. Could send a message that morning just to say thinking of him, nothing heavy.
Reggie wants to start learning the saxophone. Retiring end of March 2027 and says that's his project.

Pieter's partner Moira is 50 on 2 November 2026 and he's throwing a surprise dinner on the Saturday night at 8. Asked me to keep her busy that afternoon. She loves gardening and Agatha Christie, so maybe a first edition if I can find one. Also she can't eat gluten so tell the restaurant.
Text Rhys tomorrow evening to see how the wedding dress fitting went for Mia.
Eli got engaged!
ok so the plan for Saturday: 10am gym, then haircut at 12, then the market. Sunday lunch at mum and dad's.
Duc's wife is having a C section on Wednesday 29 October at 8am. He's a bit worried. Message him Wednesday night.
Milan and Marta's wedding photos finally came back, they look amazing. Their first anniversary is 5 Dec.

um, voice note, Ravi's little girl Aanya is starting nursery in January 2027 and he's dreading it more than she is, he said she's obsessed with dinosaurs at the moment so maybe a dino book for her birthday which is, I think, the 20th of November
Kenji's sister just had her baby in Osaka, first grandchild for his parents. They're flying out on the 3rd.
Michael proposed to Khadija on her birthday, Tuesday night at the restaurant. She said yes. Wedding probably autumn 2027.

Patrick into: cycling, sourdough, Wordle streaks. Hates fuss on his birthday. Khadija said last year he sulked when they did a surprise party, so this time just a quiet pint with him and Michael on the Friday after work, maybe 6ish, and a nice bottle of something. He mentioned a new bike computer he's been eyeing too.
Lila's baby shower Sunday 16 November 2026, 1pm, at her sister's. Bring something from the registry, I'll do the nappy cake.
Alice and Siddharth's housewarming was meant to be tomorrow but it's postponed, his dad's in hospital.
Remember to post Julia's anniversary card by Wednesday morning so it arrives Friday.
Bumped into Camila. Her brother Rhys and his wife just had a little girl, Ivy, born Monday at 11pm. Camila's an auntie for the first time and over the moon.
Omar's 40th: party Sat 13 Dec 2026, 7:30pm at the cricket club. Chipping in for a watch with Vikram and Chen. Remind me to transfer my share to Vikram by Sunday.
Adriana's had a tough pregnancy, gestational diabetes. Scan Thursday 11am. Her husband Jamal can't get time off so I'm driving her.
Kerry Reyes from accounts is leaving to have her baby, last day 28 Nov. Card going round, sign it.

Long chat with Tanvi tonight. She and Karan are trying to plan the christening for their son but both families want different churches and dates, his mum wants March 2027, hers wants it this December. Tanvi is stressed and says she'd rather just do a naming party in the garden. Also she mentioned going back to work in February, three days a week. Check in with her this weekend.
Shreya likes: matcha, Studio Ghibli, anything lavender scented.
Nik (Nikolai) said he and his wife are celebrating 15 years married on Friday, he's taking her to the Lakes for the weekend. I'm feeding their cat Pickle while they're away.
Need to buy a present for Reggie's grandson's christening, it's 23 November at 10:30. Silver spoon or something?

Catch up with Kerry and her husband over dinner. They got married in Crete in June and are already talking about a baby. Their niece Mia was the flower girl and apparently stole the show. Kerry has just started a new job at the council, seems to like it. She mentioned her 35th is 8 January 2027 and she wants a spa day, so maybe go halves with Julia on a voucher. Don't forget to ask Julia about it on Monday.
Grocery list: milk, eggs, bin bags, birthday candles, gift wrap.
Uncle Pieter and Auntie Marta's 40th wedding anniversary next Saturday at 4pm, family lunch at theirs. Mum asked me to bring the photo album. Must call Marta beforehand about numbers.
